entries.statement: D is all strict total orders on four neutral labels a,b,c,d with a least,d greatest and b,c interior; physical X is fixed x0<x1<x2<x3; only endpoint correspondences are given; T=[b<E c] is fixed independently of map choice.
entries.domain: Four-element finite logical completions, not actual worlds of identical complete organization.
all_premises: No middle relation or rank-based identity in data
entries.counterexamples_and_limits: Full E or a fixed common q-preservation bridge is extra information.

entries.statement: Exactly two completions satisfy the partial setup; each admits an endpoint-oriented betweenness map from X, but their fixed named targets T differ. In both, f(x1)<E f(x2); that map-dependent expression does not identify T.
entries.domain: Every completion in the declared four-label domain.
entries.proof: Enumerate the two middle permutations; identity and middle-swap maps are respective increasing isomorphisms. §2.
entries.counterexamples_and_limits: Does not refute R175 correspondence completion or show any actual C1 counterexample.

entries.statement: Fix producer events Bp,Cp at tB<tC, bound consumer-use events Bu,Cu at uB=tB+dB,uC=tC+dC, with dB,dC>=0; g=tC-tB>0. Fix one episode/consumer and content identity; use is executed, not a timestamp label.
entries.domain: Real-valued finite times in one stipulated model episode; no physical or phenomenal instantiation asserted.
entries.counterexamples_and_limits: Actual application requires grounding; multiple consumers and reconstructed order need separate target specification.

entries.statement: uB is greater than, equal to, or less than uC exactly as dB-dC is greater than, equal to, or less than g. For (tB,tC,dB,dC)=(1,2,2,0), production and use orders disagree. H_prod and H_use give opposing conditional predictions for one fixed named target; neither bridge is established.
entries.domain: All real parameters satisfying CAUSAL_DELAY_SETUP; named bridge predictions only if the respective separately stipulated bridge holds.
entries.counterexamples_and_limits: Not an observed experiential reversal; equal case gives no strict order; not agency/familiarity conclusion.
